969-2137-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
969-2137-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2464-2506-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2464-2506-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-2506-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-2443-2841-7885.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-7885.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

341-586-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

728-3534-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
You control seven or more lands with different names.
728-3534-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-3534-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

997-3197-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2653-2893-6763-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1558-7903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Dwarves that don't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1558-7903.description:
Deal combat damage using three Dwarves. Thorin's first ability triggers three times, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1558-7903.notes: If an opponent controls a battle, you can deal damage to that battle instead if desired.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1987-2556-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2556-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1987-2556-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2033-4068-7686.notablePrerequisites:
You control four or more Squirrels.
You control at least one Mountain.
2033-4068-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-4068-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

891-2921-5617.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-2178-4023-4840-5870.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers four times.
Resolve all Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}{E} and gain 5 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Dr Madison Li triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1765-2440-5115-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it. Then, activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
1765-2440-5115-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

222-527-5147-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5147-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

338-5086-5183-5231-6705.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-5086-5183-5231-6705.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-1308-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-1308-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1850-4935-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4935-5411.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1737-2511-4853-5004.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2781-4605-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
2781-4605-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

573-774-3875.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1651-2557-4330.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has fought this turn.
1651-2557-4330.description:
Activate Boxing Ring by tapping it, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Boxing Ring.
Repeat.

2493-2596-3821-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
2493-2596-3821-4050.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Repeat.

624-3913.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying {1}{U}, without using {R}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Crypt Champion.
Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Phantasmal Image trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Resolve the first Phantasmal Image trigger, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Crypt Champion.
Repeat from step 2.

2492-3368-4036.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Seething Song.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Seething Song.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Reiterate.
Resolve the Reiterate copy, creating a copy of Seething Song.
Resolve the second Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the first copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 5.

4242-4479-5003.notablePrerequisites: It is currently your upkeep step.
4242-4479-5003.description:
Activate Life Chisel by sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Life Chisel trigger, gaining 4 life.
Repeat.

892-1953-2105.description:
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
